name: Social Media by Eclincher
tagline: Schedules posts and answers every comment, message and review in one place
description: It covers the working day of a social team end to end: queueing and sending posts out across more than a dozen networks, then gathering everything that comes back, from private messages to public reviews, into one place to be answered from. Live performance figures sit alongside the replies.
author: eclincher
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
